summary: Frontend-only styling test of pill buttons/chips and hover animations (desktop 1920 and mobile 390). Every .jd-btn-solid/.jd-btn-outline/.jd-btn-light on /, /rent, /rent/all, /buy, /lend, /creators, /bag/sample-01, /register, the filter sheet, and the request and offer dialogs has border-radius 9999px. Hover works on all enabled buttons: they lift 2px and get a shadow. Outline buttons fill from the bottom, their text turns light and stays readable, and z-index -1 with isolation keeps the text above the fill. Solid and light buttons show the shimmer sweep. Hero 'Lend your bag' and 'Contact the team' have readable inverted colours on hover. Chips are rounded: open-filters-button, offer suggestion chips, creator interest chips, register role buttons, product-top-lender badge, quick-view buttons. Plan and handoff option cards have a 22px radius. The rent search bar is a pill on desktop with the pill Search button inside, and a 28px rounded stacked card on mobile. Search works on desktop (city=Boston gave 3 bags) and on mobile. Regression checks passed: the disabled Request to rent button does not lift (opacity 0.4, transform none), the request dialog opens once dates are chosen, the offer dialog opens and chips set the amount, the filter sheet opens with pill Clear/Show buttons, and the creator application submits successfully. No horizontal overflow on any page at 390px. One real bug: disabled outline buttons lose their text on hover.

ui_bugs.issue: On hover, a disabled outline button's text turns light (#F3F1ED) but the dark fill is held back by :not(:disabled), so the text becomes almost invisible on a transparent background. Cause: the 'hover:text-[#F3F1ED]' applied inside .jd-btn-outline is not limited to enabled buttons. Seen on CreateListing step 1 'Back' (listing-back-button) and Journey 'Previous' (journey-prev).

issues: 'Contact the team' (creators-hero-email) has a 'transition-colors' utility that replaces the .jd-btn transition-property, so the lift and shadow snap into place instead of animating. Remove transition-colors.

The full-width pill Search button sits flush against the card's left, right and bottom edges with no inner padding, which looks slightly cramped. Optional: add a small inset (e.g. p-1.5 on mobile too).
booking-dates-trigger keeps square corners (radius 0) while the option cards next to it are 22px. Possibly intentional, but it looks inconsistent.

action_items: In index.css, change outline hover text to '.jd-btn-outline:not(:disabled):hover { color: #F3F1ED }' instead of the unscoped 'hover:text-[#F3F1ED]', so disabled outline buttons stay readable
Remove 'transition-colors' from creators-hero-email so the lift animates
Optional: add an inner inset for the mobile RentSearch submit button; consider rounding booking-dates-trigger
critical_code_review_comments: The hero 'Lend your bag' and 'Contact the team' links use plain .jd-btn with bg-swap hover instead of the outline fill-sweep, so their animation does not match the other outline buttons (acceptable, but inconsistent)
seed_data_creation: One creator application was submitted via the UI (name TEST_Creator, email test_creator@example.com). The creator email is mocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Styling-only iteration. Pill/hover checks were done with getComputedStyle (borderTopLeftRadius 9999px, transform matrix(...,-2) on hover, ::before scaleY for outline buttons, ::after translateX for the shimmer). Catalogue search testid is catalogue-search-*; /rent uses rent-search-*. The product page Top Lender testid is product-top-lender.
